prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 51.3 °C (65% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 56.0 °C (56% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 57.6 °C (48% above healthy). Elevated hydraulic oil temperature and reduced heat dissipation across the exchanger indicate severe cooler malfunction.
Valve: small lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.84 s (within 1% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.46 s (within 2% of healthy). Minor delay in pressure rise and slight inter-sensor switching lag indicate beginning valve actuation lag.
Pump leakage: no leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.58 l/min (within 1% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 361 W·min/l (6% below healthy). No internal bypassing detected; volumetric efficiency is optimal.
Accumulator: severely reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 45.6 bar (2% below healthy). Dampening capacity is substantially impaired, producing high-frequency pressure oscillations across the circuit.
